note: MG-09 (BTC-lite): which discovery registry reads are evidence for which BTC bank question (primed BTC Question Bank.yaml). Conservative: a read is listed only when its get_command returns the export or query the question's evidence_required validation names. `answer_on_verdict` is set only where the entry's verdict predicate (verdictPredicates.json) reads the very fact the question asks; otherwise the capture is evidence only and the answer stays open. A virtual question id (BTC.DEV.002.CA_ENFORCEMENT_PROOF) counts only for the runlist entry it substitutes.
